Mantap! Semua sudah lengkap. Berikut **ringkasan final** sebelum paper di-generate:

---

### 📋 FINAL SETUP — SLR Paper

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| 🎓 **Jurusan** | Teknik Informatika |
| 🔬 **Topik** | Solar Plant Power Production Forecasting with Machine/Deep Learning |
| 📝 **Jenis** | Systematic Literature Review (SLR) |
| 🏗️ **Metode SLR** | PRISMA 2020 |

| RQ | Research Question |
|----|-------------------|
| 1 | Metode ML/DL apa yang paling banyak digunakan untuk forecasting produksi solar plant? |
| 2 | Apa saja input variable/feature yang paling berpengaruh terhadap akurasi prediksi? |
| 3 | Bagaimana performa deep learning dibanding machine learning tradisional? |
| 4 | Apa tantangan utama & gap penelitian di bidang ini? |

| Parameter | Detail |
|-----------|--------|
| 📅 **Rentang** | 2021–2025 |
| 📚 **Database** | Scopus + ScienceDirect + IEEE |
| ✅ **Inklusi** | Bahasa Inggris, akses terbuka |
| ❌ **Eksklusi** | Paper review / survey |
| ✍️ **Citation** | IEEE |
| 🌐 **Bahasa** | English |

| Analisis | Status |
|----------|--------|
| 🔵 **Thematic Analysis** | ✅ — Klasifikasi model, fitur, performa |
| 🔵 **Meta-Analysis** | ✅ — Perbandingan numerik (RMSE, MAE, R²) |
| 🔵 **Content Analysis** | ✅ — Frekuensi & tren metode/fitur |
| 🔵 **Comparative Analysis** | ✅ — Tabel perbandingan antar model |

| 🎯 **Kesimpulan Target** | Performa antar model (ML vs DL) & gap penelitian |
